title: Commercial and industrial property tax replaces stamp duty (Victoria)
summary: From 1 July 2024 commercial and industrial property enters a new regime on its next sale: duty is paid once, and an annual property tax replaces duty on later transfers, starting ten years after entry.

instruments.title: Commercial and Industrial Property Tax Reform Act 2024 (Vic)

commenced.what: Properties begin entering the reformed regime on their first sale

direction_rationale: Stamp duty on commercial and industrial property raises the cost of moving premises; abolishing or replacing it should make it cheaper for firms to relocate, expand and match to better sites.
comparison: Other states that kept commercial stamp duty
confounders: commercial property cycle and interest rates
notes: The duty saving applies only to transfers after a property has entered the scheme; the tax starts ten years after entry.
